label.rationale: At observed_at every required context that had concluded was green and CI Summary was still running; nothing is red, so the head waits for CI Summary.

provenance.read: GitHub REST check-runs API at the head sha, every page, filter=all; failed-step, run and annotation facts from the jobs, runs and annotations APIs; named_blockers parsed from the CI Summary job's own final report
provenance.reconstruction_rule: Snapshot as of observed_at, rebuilt from the live read: copies that started after observed_at are left out, a copy that completed after it reads in_progress, the caller-change flag is recomputed against the last base commit before observed_at, and the companion state comes from its created, merged and closed times. merge_state is not recoverable for a past moment; it is reconstructed as blocked because a required context (CI Summary) had not completed at observed_at.
